gate: an attribute is shown when a player's odd matches predict his even ones (Spearman >= 0.5, player-seasons of 1,800+ minutes); keepers are read apart

not_readable.field of view and scanning: needs video or tracking (head movements before receiving)
not_readable.pace and work rate: tracking is published only for the Premier League and the Champions League from 2024/25: a club's own tracking would add it

as_first_written.note: rare events left out after seeing these (see the module's docstring)

vision.label: Vision
vision.reads: what his passing finds for its volume (xA, chances, final-third passes per pass), beyond set-piece duty

composure.label: Composure
composure.reads: keeps the ball when it's on him: how rarely he's dispossessed per touch, for how often he takes players on

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.reads: lapses per 90: errors leading to a goal, penalties conceded, own goals

discipline.label: Discipline
discipline.reads: how rarely he fouls, per 90 (cards aren't in these data)

consistency.label: Consistency
consistency.reads: how little his match-by-match output swings (matches of 60+ minutes)

big_games.label: Big games
big_games.reads: his output against the top quarter of his league, minus against the rest

discrimination_rule: Franks et al. 2016: share of the spread between players that is the players (bootstrap of each player's matches, 60 draws, player-seasons of 1,800+ minutes); shown only if >= 0.5
